profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Tanium
profile.summary: A compassionate software engineer with extensive background in Java, as well as ministry experiences in church and hospital settings. I will provide robust and scalable software solutions and also a shoulder to cry on, if needed.

positions.title: Chaplain Resident
positions.description:
Provided spiritual and emotional support to patients and staff in a clinical setting. Also performed:
• Palliative care spiritual assessments
• Adult end-of-life/decedent care and fetal demise family care
• Facilitated completion of advance directive (medical power of attorney, living will) paperwork
• Staff support
• Remote spiritual care
• Notary services

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Conference planning/abstract submission web application for international conference
•	Frontend development in Vue.js
•	Built on Laravel platform
•	Integration with REST API from PayPal, then Stripe, for online payments
•	Node.js backend service
•	Atlassian bug/feature tracking system used for team management

company.name: Aldersgate United Methodist Church, College Station

positions.title: Director of Community Ministries Development
positions.description: Developed small group ministries in coordination with the head pastor of a local church for the area of Bryan/College Station. Also engaged young adults and college-age students in church activities and community outreach projects.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
•	Senior developer and project manager for an advanced microscopy image analysis tool
•	Written completely in Java
•	Tracking/location algorithms at nanometer resolution in 3D for single-molecule particles in live cell fluorescence microscopy images
•	Image display and overlays were implemented in JOGL
•	OpenCL kernels/shaders provided GPU acceleration of optimization algorithms
•	Maven service to maintain dependencies
•	Interfaced with Zeiss Microscopes using USB/Serial port connections
